scope.reason: Recompute paragraph text and line breaks from stored markup: retain a line break when its newline survives whitespace trimming and drop it when the newline is removed; paragraph AST has no separate feature storage. Normalize repeated block identities and publisher head-matter order before reading stored decisions; AST identities and roles have no independent feature storage. Multiline preamble titles and document-unique block anchors are rebuilt from stored markup, alongside paragraph text, paragraph numbers and anonymization markers before whitespace trimming, including unpainted non-breaking-space redaction runs and uneven letter-spaced chunks witnessed by intact words; none has feature storage of its own.
